title: Integrate final rehearsal source
goal: After T005 is terminal and reviewed on the exact T006 integration base, establish one final reviewed non-main Heim-PC source revision containing the integrated T001/T002 state plus T005 rehearsal-harness changes, validate it in an isolated final-integration worktree, publish an exact durable non-main branch, and create the leased content-addressed whole-source artifact that T003 must consume without reading the live Git object store or mutable checkout.

approval.note: This task may read and mutate only the exclusively reserved Heim-PC Git object/ref store, its dedicated /home/alex/repos/.grabowski-heim-pc-nixos-t007-integration worktree and branch nixos-migration-v1-t007-final-integration as needed to establish, validate and publish the exact non-main final-integration revision from the T006 base plus exact terminal T005 source, and may create the bound rehearsal-source artifact. It does not merge to main and grants no runtime, storage, EFI, firmware, reboot or production-cutover authority.

acceptance.assertion: T007 begins only after T006 and T005 are terminal and independently reviewed. Evidence binds the exact T006 integration commit/tree, the exact T005 terminal commit/tree and proves T005 was implemented from that exact T006 base. Missing ancestry, source drift, dirty state or ambiguous identity fails closed before integration mutation.

Before reading commit/tree objects or creating final-integration refs, the task holds the exclusive component.heim-pc.nixos-source-integration claim materialized as path:/home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git; lease loss or object/ref-store drift fails closed before another Git mutation.

All index/tree mutation and validation occurs only in the leased /home/alex/repos/.grabowski-heim-pc-nixos-t007-integration worktree on the leased non-main branch nixos-migration-v1-t007-final-integration. The productive Heim-PC checkout and main branch are not mutated; wrong branch, wrong worktree, dirty preimage or lease loss fails closed.

If the exact terminal T005 commit is already a verified descendant of the exact T006 integration commit with no unrelated delta, it is adopted as the final integration revision; otherwise a dedicated receipt-bound merge/rebase/cherry-pick result is produced and independently reviewed. Tree comparison proves the final revision contains exactly the reviewed T006 source plus reviewed T005 changes and no unrelated source change.

While holding the exact branch lease repo:/home/alex/repos/heim-pc:branch:nixos-migration-v1-t007-final-integration, the exact final integration revision is published only to that dedicated non-main branch and remote readback proves it resolves to the reviewed commit/tree. T003 receives exact commit/tree identities, never a moving ref as authority.

Focused T001/T002/T005 tests plus required Heim-PC repository validation are green in the isolated final-integration worktree on the exact final integration revision, and independent review finds no material integration regression before the rehearsal-source artifact is published.

While holding the exclusive artifact.heim-pc.nixos-rehearsal-source write claim, T007 creates a content-addressed whole-source artifact and immutable manifest from the exact reviewed final integration revision. The manifest binds Git commit/tree, archive/content digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity; immediate independent re-hash/readback proves artifact contents match the bound source tree.

The T007 terminal evidence designates the exact final integration commit/tree and content-addressed rehearsal-source artifact as T003's only declarative/reconstruction source. T003 fails closed if the artifact digest, manifest, source commit/tree or Control Release Set/lock binding differs.
T007 performs no main-branch merge, production NixOS activation, partitioning, formatting, LUKS/EFI/Secure-Boot/firmware mutation, reboot or equivalent production-cutover effect.
